notes: The encounter arms via the #mg hash hook (no verb trigger). On arm, 8 grey nomads appear in a ring at distance 180. The flame brightness (0-1) decays constantly and rises on left-click. Nomads approach (r shrinks) and commit (commit rises) when the flame is in the steady band (0.42-0.58, near the drifting target). If the flame flares too bright (>0.75) or dims too low (<0.25), nomads recoil or fade and may die. Win: all nomads reach r<50 with commit>0.85 (they kneel, saturate to gold, convert to devout). Fail: all nomads die (bright flash or dim fade, apply burnout or drift_apathy). The player can still move (WASD) but clicks are captured. Entry transition: 48-frame desaturate fade. Exit: 120-frame kneel-and-saturate (win) or 60-frame scatter-fade (fail). The flame is drawn above the player's head; nomad posture (lean, opacity, edge-glow) signals their state. Tuned for ~30-60s play; survives 10s idle before nomads drift away.
